scripts.cdk:deploy:dev: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://dev-api.homechrome.lldlab.com NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://dev-store.homechrome.lldlab.com npx @opennextjs/aws build && cd infra && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never -c environment=dev -c certArn=arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:163053486005:certificate/a8dca48d-5992-4e6e-94c9-fffc7f3ac447 && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name HomechromeStoreStack-dev --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text) --paths '/*'
scripts.cdk:deploy:prod: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.homechrome.lldlab.com NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://homechrome.lldlab.com npx @opennextjs/aws build && cd infra && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never -c environment=prod -c certArn=arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:163053486005:certificate/a8dca48d-5992-4e6e-94c9-fffc7f3ac447 && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name HomechromeStoreStack-prod --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text) --paths '/*'
